recommendations.title: Increase water intake frequency (every 15-20 minutes if outdoors)
recommendations.rationale: HeatLens score 62.7 (High, uncalibrated), driven by WBGT (Humidity) — dehydration risk rises with either heat load.
recommendations.basis: NIOSH Heat Stress: Hydration fact sheet (2017): 1 cup (8 oz) of water every 15-20 minutes when working in the heat

recommendations.title: Community health workers to check on elderly residents living alone
recommendations.rationale: Elderly (60+) share 7.9% (Census 2011, Ahmedabad district urban population, the same figure for every ward). Older adults sweat less and store more heat (see the source reviews).
recommendations.basis: Reviews on older adults and heat cited by the HeatLens heat-debt model (PMC12481594; Lancet 2021)

hap_trigger_basis: White - No Alert: city max temperature 36.9 C (Open-Meteo forecast) against AMC thresholds (Yellow >= 41.1 C, Orange >= 43.1 C, Red >= 45.0 C; AMC Heat Action Plan 2019 (Easy Read), section IV.A 'Color Signals for Heat Alert', p.3). Context, not used for the level: HeatLens thermal-stress band High; published-heatwave exposure tier below_threshold.

health.source: de Bont et al., Environ Int 2024;184:108461 (PMC11790314)

cap_preview.headline: AMC White - No Alert - Isanpur, 2026-10-02
cap_preview.description: HeatLens score 62.7 (High), regime MODERATE, dominant driver WBGT (Humidity). Uncalibrated HeatLens composite index - not a validated health-outcome forecast.
